properties.name: Bradbury Landing
properties.source_name: NASA/JPL news: NASA Mars Rover Begins Driving at Bradbury Landing (Aug 2012)
properties.description: Curiosity's landing site inside Gale crater (5 Aug 2012 PDT), named by NASA after author Ray Bradbury. Position = first rover waypoint, before the first drive.
properties.science_value: Start of the mission; reference point for the whole traverse.

properties.name: John Klein (first drill hole)
properties.source_name: NASA/JPL: NASA Curiosity Rover Collects First Martian Bedrock Sample
properties.description: First rock drilled on Mars (sol 182, 8 Feb 2013) in Sheepbed mudstone, Yellowknife Bay. CheMin and SAM results pointed to an ancient wet environment that could have supported microbes.
properties.science_value: First evidence of a habitable ancient environment in Gale.

properties.name: Hidden Valley (sand hazard)
properties.source_name: NASA/JPL news release 2014-279; NASA image 'Curiosity Tracks in Hidden Valley' (sol 709)
properties.description: Sandy valley floor where wheels slipped more than expected in Aug 2014 (Navcam sol 709); the team reversed and drove out to the northeast.
properties.science_value: Real lesson for route planning: sand-filled lows are a mobility hazard.

properties.name: Elemental sulfur discovery (Gediz Vallis channel)
properties.source_name: NASA/JPL: NASA's Curiosity Rover Discovers a Surprise in a Martian Rock (2024)
properties.description: On 30 May 2024 the rover drove over and cracked a rock, revealing yellow crystals identified as elemental sulfur, the first found on Mars. Sol ~4200 is ESTIMATED (NASA gives 'Snow Lake' close-up on sol 4209 = 8 June, nine days later).
properties.science_value: First pure sulfur on Mars; shows the channel's unusual chemistry.

properties.name: Sulfate unit to boxwork contact
properties.source_name: Siebach et al., GSA 2025 abstract (per SESSION_HANDOFF.md); NASA blog sols 4804-4811 (boxwork Phase 1 began sol 4534)
properties.description: Where Curiosity left the layered sulfate unit and entered the boxwork region (sol 4534). NASA's blog dates boxwork campaign Phase 1 to sols 4534-4570. GSA 2025 abstract URL to be added (not verified here).
properties.science_value: Key geologic boundary; start of the boxwork campaign and of our EVA box route.

properties.name: Altadena (first boxwork drill)
properties.source_name: NASA/JPL: NASA's Curiosity Mars Rover Starts Unpacking Boxwork Formations (23 Jun 2025); blog sols 4563-4565
properties.description: First drill sample of the boxwork campaign, on a ridge edge, June 2025. Drill sol 4564 is INFERRED (blog: drilling on the second sol of the 4563-4565 plan; post-brush image sol 4561).
properties.science_value: Baseline composition of boxwork bedrock.

properties.name: Monte Grande (boxwork hollow)
properties.source_name: NASA blog: Curiosity Blog, Sols 4695-4701: Searching for Answers at Monte Grande
properties.description: Boxwork hollow studied in Oct 2025; Mastcam mosaics of its walls. Hollow drill target Valle de la Luna lies here.
properties.science_value: Example of a boxwork hollow: compare with ridges for how boxwork formed.

properties.name: Valle de la Luna (44th drill hole)
properties.source_name: NASA blogs: Sols 4689-4694 'Drill in the Boxwork Unit is GO!' and Sols 4695-4701 (44th hole)
properties.description: Drill target in the Monte Grande hollow, drilled around 18-19 Oct 2025 (Mastcam image of the hole on sol 4693); Curiosity's 44th hole. Exact drill sol not stated.
properties.science_value: Hollow sample for the ridge-vs-hollow comparison.

properties.name: Nevado Sajama (ridge-top drill)
properties.source_name: NASA blog: Curiosity Blog, Sols 4716-4722: Drilling Success at Nevado Sajama
properties.description: Ridge-top drill target; drilling completed on sol 4718 (13 Nov 2025) after APXS, ChemCam and MAHLI checks.
properties.science_value: Ridge sample for the ridge-vs-hollow comparison.

properties.name: Nevado Sajama 2 (second ridge drill)
properties.source_name: NASA blog: Curiosity Blog Sols 4804-4811: Kicking Off the Final Phase of Boxwork Exploration
properties.description: Second drill at Nevado Sajama; MAHLI image sol 4803 (9 Feb 2026); final activities completed that week before the last boxwork phase.
properties.science_value: Repeat sample at the same ridge site.

properties.name: Nazca (49th drill hole)
properties.source_name: NASA blog title 'Curiosity Blog, Sols 5050-5055: It's Nazca, Our 49th Drill Hole' (title seen in site sidebar; page NOT read)
properties.description: 49th drill hole, sols 5050-5055 per the NASA blog title. Details NOT verified (page not read); position = rover waypoint at sol 5050.
properties.science_value: Bedrock sample just above the boxwork (per a later blog, to verify).

properties.name: Curiosity position, sol 5073 (latest in data)
properties.source_name: NASA MMGIS MSL waypoints (latest in our download)
properties.description: Last waypoint in the waypoint file downloaded 14 Nov 2026 (sol 5073). Not live.
properties.science_value: Where the rover was most recently, per our data.
